verdict.rationale: Shopify POS has its own developer API reference for POS UI extensions on shopify.dev. It documents APIs such as shopify.storage, shopify.toast and shopify.action.presentModal(), plus CLI scaffolding and GraphQL Admin API access via fetch(). Nothing in the evidence shows the reference is interactive or that its examples can be run in-browser. missing for 10: evidence of an interactive API explorer, runnable/live code examples, independent or hands-on corroboration of the reference experience
